title: Illegal Address-Phase Change During a Wait State
description: The master corrupts a pending SEQ address phase by changing HTRANS and HADDR while HREADY remains low.

annotations.message: The master starts a write burst with a NONSEQ address phase at 0xA0.
Data for 0xA0 is stalled. The next SEQ address 0xA4 is visible but not yet accepted, so every address/control signal must remain stable.
Protocol violation: HREADY is still low, but the master changes HTRANS, HADDR, and HWRITE. The pending 0xA4 beat is lost.
HREADY finally rises and completes the old data phase, but the illegal change has already corrupted the burst.

violations.message: Address/control changed while HREADY was low; the master must hold the pending address phase stable.
